title: Glossy
description: A minecraft texture pack that adds a glossy feel to the textures.
body: This is a Minecraft texture pack that adds a **_glossy_** feel to the PvP aspect of the game. It enhances weapons, armor, and tools with smooth highlights and reflective-style shading to create a cleaner, more polished look during combat. The textures are designed to make key PvP items stand out more clearly in fights, improving visual clarity while keeping the classic Minecraft style. Overall, it gives battles a sharper, more modern aesthetic without changing the core gameplay experience.
